A rollup of the recent dark-theme fixes plus a new one: the Event Scripter script editor now opens on the Dark theme. Just **force update**; your `/config` is untouched.

## Fixed

### Event Scripter script editor now opens on the Dark theme

The Event Scripter extension's script editor (**edit** and **Add script**) did nothing while the Dark theme was active: the editor window never opened, so scripts could not be edited or added. It now opens normally on both Light and Dark.

Two latent NullPointerExceptions in JDownloader/AppWork code surface only under the FlatLaf dark look-and-feel and were swallowed silently, aborting the editor dialog before it could show:

- AppWork's `CircledProgressBar` UI dereferenced a null back-reference during layout when FlatLaf re-created the transient progress widget.
- jsyntaxpane's `ScriptAction` dereferenced a null `javax.script` engine (the current Java runtime ships no built-in JavaScript engine) while installing the code-editor kit.

The container's in-process agent now guards both at the root with a load-time bytecode transform, so the editor opens without changing the Carbon `#161616` dark theme in any way. The guard is fail-safe: if the guarded code ever changes upstream, the original behaviour is used unchanged. (Reported on the Unraid forum, thanks kayn.)

### Dark theme (JD Plain Dark) visibility fixes

- **Unchecked checkboxes were nearly invisible.** On the dark `#161616` theme an unchecked checkbox (and radio button) had almost no visible outline. The border is now a clear light grey, so an empty box reads just as well as a ticked one.
- **The package expand/collapse toggle (`[+]` / `[-]`) rendered black.** After a JDownloader self-update the little toggle next to a package could turn black and vanish on the dark background. It is now always drawn in light grey.
- **Download progress bars flashed grey while scrolling.** Scrolling a package's file list briefly greyed out some progress bars. The bar fill is now unified, so scrolling no longer causes a grey flash.

### Stability

- **Black screen / crash loop after updating (`UnsupportedClassVersionError`).** The container's dialog agent had been compiled with a newer Java than the runtime, so the Java 21 JVM refused to load it and the desktop stayed black. The agent is now always compiled for the runtime's Java version, and the CI smoke test fails on any agent load failure or relaunch loop, so a broken agent can no longer reach a published image.
